observations: White chest freezer with a top-opening lid.
Interior walls are made of silver-colored metal.
The interior floor has a divided section with a visible seam.
The lid features a circular vent and a temperature control knob.
The exterior front has a control panel with a power indicator light and a rotary dial.
The rear shows the cooling coils and a power cord.
The bottom edge of the unit shows significant paint peeling and rust.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not legible on the rating plate.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or may have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the interior frost forming or the exterior cooling coils getting cold.

risks.risk: The compressor may be noisy or have a mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with the lid open.
risks.if_unproven: as having a noisy or broken compressor

risks.risk: The cooling coils may be clogged with dust or debris.
risks.proof: A photo of the coils with the protective grille removed.

proof_requests: Video of the freezer running with the lid open.
Photo of the rating plate showing the brand and capacity.
Photo of the cooling coils with the grille removed.
Photo of the interior showing the frost level.
response.reason: The item is a standard Haier chest freezer. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit due to the unproven mechanical condition.
